article.description: Ranchi Municipal Corporation to install 5,300 LED street lights before festivals, adding to 60,000 existing lights, with 3-year maintenance and rapid repairs citywide.
article.articleTextExcerpt: Outdoor Lighting 2 min read Ranchi civic body to install 5,300 LED street lights across city The civic body has floated a tender inviting eligible companies to supply, install, test and commission LED street lights of 75 W, 90 W and 120 W capacities. The contract also includes related services and three years of comprehensive maintenance. Kelly Kislaya TNN Published On Sep 19, 2026 at 07:06 PM IST RANCHI: With the festive season approaching, the Ranchi Municipal Corporation (RMC) has initiated steps to illuminate dark spots and narrow lanes across the city by installing 5,300 new LED street lights.The civic body has floated a tender inviting eligible companies to supply, install, test and commission LED street lights of 75 W, 90 W and 120 W capacities. The contract also includes related services and three years of comprehensive maintenance.The new lights will supplement the existing network of around 60,000 street lights across Ranchi. Sourabh Keshri, assistant engineer in RMC’s lights section, said the energy department had already installed poles in previously unlit lanes to ensure that no dark spots remained within the civic body’s jurisdiction before the festivities. needsReviewNews.title: Ranchi civic body to install 5,300 LED street lights across city
needsReviewNews.description: Ranchi Municipal Corporation to install 5,300 LED street lights before festivals, adding to 60,000 existing lights, with 3-year maintenance and rapid repairs citywide.
needsReviewNews.articleTextExcerpt: Outdoor Lighting 2 min read Ranchi civic body to install 5,300 LED street lights across city The civic body has floated a tender inviting eligible companies to supply, install, test and commission LED street lights of 75 W, 90 W and 120 W capacities. The contract also includes related services and three years of comprehensive maintenance. Kelly Kislaya TNN Published On Sep 19, 2026 at 07:06 PM IST RANCHI: With the festive season approaching, the Ranchi Municipal Corporation (RMC) has initiated steps to illuminate dark spots and narrow lanes across the city by installing 5,300 new LED street lights.The civic body has floated a tender inviting eligible companies to supply, install, test and commission LED street lights of 75 W, 90 W and 120 W capacities. The contract also includes related services and three years of comprehensive maintenance.The new lights will supplement the existing network of around 60,000 street lights across Ranchi. Sourabh Keshri, assistant engineer in RMC’s lights section, said the energy department had already installed poles in previously unlit lanes to ensure that no dark spots remained within the civic body’s jurisdiction before the festivities.
